answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system with a proof-of-stake inlet to resist Sybil attacks. Each agent's identity is assigned a unique digital fingerprint, acting as a mirror to reflect its honest participation. A prism of validator nodes assesses agent behavior, penalizing malicious activity by slashing staked tokens. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would need to acquire and lock up a substantial amount of tokens, making it economically infeasible.
